checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard on pavement outside café
must.why: A-frame board stands on the paving in front of the door.
Reads COFFEE / TO GO, but the second line is small and soft.

must.item: Words on sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: Text sits flat on the board face and looks like chalk.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, shadow
must.why: Board is fairly large and has little visible cast shadow. It covers the lower door area.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables, wide composition intact
must.why: Everything else looks unchanged and the framing is the same.

faults.what: Shadow and ground contact are weak, so the sign looks slightly pasted in.
Sign is somewhat large and blocks the bottom of the door.
'TO GO' line is small and blurry.

summary: The output adds a believable A-frame chalkboard reading COFFEE TO GO in front of the café door with the rest of the photo preserved, though the shadow is weak and the sign is a bit big.
